text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet achieved spectacular results in the Twinkle Series,
truly worthy of the "Number One Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having completed those truly precious "first three years,"
she now takes her first steps onto a brand-new path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lost in a sea of diverse thoughts,
I spent some time in my room, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are you taking a break for?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's me.
Do you really need to look that surprised?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you're spacing out way too much...
You're thinking something like, "That took forever...!", aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Honestly. Even though you're my trainer,
what on earth are you thinking? Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To a place worthy of the number one Umamusume, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so she said, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Sold out again?!
Ugh, it's all because you took so long to get ready, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And today was supposed to be the restock day for the new bag, too—!
choice_data_list: I'm being dragged along for shopping...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, of course I did!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've been holding back on
sooo many things this whole time, you know!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today is an exception, though!
After all, we've wrapped up a major milestone!
choice_data_list: ...After all, you tried your absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Good, as long as you understand.
Well then, back to shopping!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I ended up accompanying her on her shopping trip—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this belt doesn't suit you either...
Hey, you, go try on another outfit.
choice_data_list: Why are you tagging along on my shopping trip...?
Why did you come with me shopping...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you have time to complain,
could you hurry up and go change back?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You're wasting my time!
Come on, shoo, shoo!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Feels like I'm more than three times
tired than I usually am after shopping.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, though, didn't you
end up with a pretty great outfit yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just as Daiwa Scarlet said,
she had completely coordinated
my entire outfit from head to toe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Don't worry about it.
It's just something that needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now then, after this is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, an airplane.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Daiwa Scarlet's gaze,
a small, blinking red light was moving across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if she's running properly
over there, too."
choice_data_list: Who do you mean by "that guy"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, of courseâ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—She's my number one rival,
and the coolest person I know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaah, overseas though, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer.
...U-Um, what if, hypothetically...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I said, "I want to go overseas,"
would you come with me?
choice_data_list: When that time comes, I'll make you the "number one" Umamusume overseas.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“......Ahaha, idiot.
I didn't say it went that far, did I?”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that's true. You're my Trainer, after all.
It's only natural you'd tag along."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, that's just the kind of person they are, so please paint them in a good light.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...A reporter?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Yes...!!
The burning bond between the two of you has resonated deeply within my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If a Trainer has an Umamusume in their care,
they'll journey to the ends of the earth and the edge of the sea
all on their own...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's just close-up coverage.
For the "Number 1 Umamusume Special Feature," you see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to meet at this cafe.
You really showed up at the perfect time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
People really said that to me all the time, you know.
Like, "Hurry up and let me do a solo interview with you!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super busy every day with races though,
so I can't help pick out your outfits at all."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's why you held back the whole time, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: So the reason you were holding back was...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! About this interview!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Now it's your turn to tell me all about the Umamusume you train!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking forward to some wonderful words
that'll blow even me away♪
choice_data_list: How about, "Scarlet is my pride," or something?
How about, "Scarlet is my pride," or something?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Stating the obvious isn't amusing in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I've always been your number one Umamusume, haven't I?
